note: Weekly video cast (KT, 27 Nov 2026: don't reuse one presenter, background and voice every time). Rule: a small recurring cast, each presenter ALWAYS with their own voice (a face and voice that match keep trust; research: spokes-character studies, Ehrenberg-Bass). The setting, outfit and framing change every video; no presenter+setting pair repeats within 8 weeks. Scripts are written for the chosen presenter's persona and setting. New presenters are generated in BHuman inside the monthly credit budget; add them here with their BHuman ids once made. Hypothesis to test, not established.
